gaps.sentence: I bumped ___ my neighbour at the dentist's.
gaps.explanation: bump into somebody = meet by chance.

gaps.sentence: The plane will drop ___ the parcels at the next farm.
gaps.explanation: drop off = deliver somebody/something; also become less (sales dropped off).

gaps.sentence: Put ___ your toys when you've finished playing.
gaps.explanation: put away = put something in its usual place.

gaps.sentence: These old boots are completely worn ___.
gaps.explanation: wear out = become thin/unusable through use.

gaps.sentence: Put ___ your coat — it's freezing outside.
gaps.explanation: put on = dress in; put off = postpone.

gaps.sentence: Prices levelled ___ after the crazy spring market.
gaps.explanation: level off = stop rising or falling and stay the same.

gaps.sentence: The negotiators refused to give ___ to the hijackers' demands.
gaps.explanation: give in (to) = stop arguing and accept; give up = quit.

gaps.sentence: The strike brought ___ major changes in the law.
